## Summary

I've resolved ticket T-4003. The cart service outage was caused by a **label selector mismatch**: the new Helm chart template (v4.2) deploys pods with the standard `app.kubernetes.io/name` label, but the Service still has the old `app: cart-service` selector. This prevented Kubernetes from creating EndpointSlices for the Service, leaving it with no backend endpoints despite the pods being Running and Ready. The fix is to update the Service selector to match the new pod labels.
